full_prompt_en: A square, graphic Western illustration layers two large weathered male faces over a red landscape crossed by small riders on horseback. The background is a broad field of saturated scarlet and dusty crimson, with dark brush marks collecting along the lower hills and corners. At the upper left, a large shadowed head in a wide-brimmed hat looks toward the left edge. Warm pale strokes pick out the cheek, nose, and tight mouth beneath the dark brim. A second, still larger face overlaps it across the right half, turning three quarters toward the viewer. This man has a rough beard, narrowed eyes, and a dark brown hat whose long brim cuts a strong diagonal across the upper center. His expression appears stern. The two heads are cropped by the frame and joined by ragged black painterly shapes, as if printed over the red field in layers. Below them, a pair of much smaller mounted figures rides forward across the lower left-center. One horse is dark and upright, another stretches into a stride; hats and coats mark the riders as simple silhouettes at this scale. A paler group of distant figures appears near the lower right slope, partly dissolved into dusty red. Sparse black strokes suggest grass, small birds, and rough terrain without filling in a fully naturalistic setting. The image relies on heavy black shadow, brick red midtones, and selective ochre highlights. Hatching and scraped contour lines give the faces and clothing a worn printed texture, while open red areas keep the composition bold. Light is represented graphically: warm accents strike the noses and cheekbones, but most forms remain in dramatic shadow, with no single realistic light source. No title or readable lettering appears in the selected panel. The overall composition has the force of an action poster, balancing monumental close faces against tiny moving silhouettes in a stark red-and-black field.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形图形化西部插画：两张巨大而饱经风霜的男子面孔叠压在红色地景上，下面有骑马的小人物穿行。背景是一大片饱和猩红和蒙尘深红，深色笔痕聚在下方山坡与角落。左上，一张戴宽檐帽的大脸隐在阴影中，望向左边缘。暖浅色笔触从深色帽檐下挑出面颊、鼻梁和紧闭的嘴。第二张更大的脸与其重叠，占据右半幅，以四分之三角度转向观众。这名男子胡茬粗重、双眼眯起，戴深褐帽子，长帽檐横过上方中央形成强斜线。他的神情严厉。两张脸都被画框截断，并由粗糙黑色绘画形块连接，像层层印在红色底上。它们下方，两个小得多的骑手从左下中央向前行进。一匹马深色而挺立，另一匹伸展步伐；在这个尺度下，帽子与外套使骑手成为简单剪影。更淡的一组远处人物出现在右下坡地，部分消散于尘红色中。稀疏黑笔痕暗示草丛、小鸟和粗糙地形，没有填成完全写实的环境。图像依靠厚重黑影、砖红中间调和有选择的赭黄亮部。排线和刮擦轮廓赋予脸与衣服磨旧的印刷肌理，开放的红色区域则保持构图鲜明。光以图形方式呈现：暖色重点打在鼻梁与颧骨上，大部分形体仍处在戏剧性阴影里，没有单一写实光源。所选画面没有标题或可读字迹。整体构图具有动作海报的力量，以纪念碑般的大特写面孔和小小移动剪影在鲜明红黑色场中取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: Graphic illustration uses a narrow, forceful palette of saturated red, heavy near-black, and selective warm pale accents. Large cropped forms overlap smaller silhouettes across shallow layers, establishing scale and drama rather than measured perspective. Rough hatching, scraped edges, and broken printed-looking marks add wear to otherwise bold color masses. Long diagonals and dark bands direct attention through the frame, while open red areas prevent the dense shadows from becoming visually clogged. Highlights are placed selectively on raised planes; lighting reads as expressive contrast rather than a fully naturalistic source. The overall effect is severe, kinetic, and poster-like, with coarse surface texture under a clear visual hierarchy.
style_prompt_zh: 图形插画采用范围狭窄却有力量的色域：饱和红、厚重近黑，以及有选择的暖浅色强调。巨大的裁切形体跨过浅层空间与更小的剪影重叠，以尺度和戏剧性而非精确透视建立画面。粗放排线、刮擦边缘和断续的印刷状笔迹为大胆色块增添磨旧感。长斜线与深色带引导视线穿过画框，开放红色区域则防止密集阴影堵塞画面。亮部有选择地落在突起平面上；光线作为表现性对比发挥作用，而非完全写实的光源。整体效果严峻、充满动势且近似海报，清楚的视觉层级之下保留粗粝表面肌理。
theme_en: Two large hat-wearing faces above riders in a red Western landscape
theme_zh: 两张戴帽的大脸俯临红色西部地景中的骑手
name: Red Dead Redemption
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
